scope: Design artifact and supported preview checks; not production A01–A31 acceptance

checks.name: Spec figure references
checks.detail: 16 generated figures exist; all six original screenshot references replaced.

checks.name: Settings draft, leave and cancel
checks.detail: Saved state disables save; edits enable it; three-way leave; cancel restores values; no budget inputs.

checks.name: Command and unique entry
checks.detail: Empty requirement remains in composer; valid sample navigates to one team button and three tabs.

checks.name: Team popover keyboard
checks.detail: Enter opens with row focus; ArrowDown moves; Escape closes and returns focus.

checks.name: Node and full conversation
checks.detail: Node opens matching read-only panels; full conversation has no composer; return restores selected agent.

checks.name: Waiting navigation and data isolation
checks.detail: UI agent has its own history and unknown budget; answer action navigates to an empty main composer.

checks.name: Topology search and list
checks.detail: Search keeps the QA parent path; equivalent hierarchy list is available.

checks.name: Communication
checks.detail: Two incoming sample records are correctly scoped and read-only.

checks.name: Compact layout
checks.detail: 1080 px artboard uses a single bottom dock with conversation/info switching.

checks.name: Mobile details
checks.detail: Node opens a full-page read-only detail with information tab and return to list.

checks.name: Small viewport and theme
checks.detail: Mobile frame has no horizontal overflow at 320 px content width; light theme applies semantic styles.

checks.name: Browser JavaScript
checks.detail: No uncaught page errors during the checked navigation flows.
